market_pulse.note: Closed Monday down 739.38 points, or 1.41%, at 51,608.17 (Yahoo Finance).
Closed Monday down 145.08 points, or 1.92%, at 7,416.59 (Yahoo Finance).
Closed Monday down 626.52 points, or 2.49%, at 24,509.76, the weakest of the three major indexes and its third straight daily loss (Yahoo Finance; CNBC headline via search).
December WTI fell $3.24, or 3.66%, to about $85.32 a barrel; Brent was last cited near $92 (Yahoo Finance).

themes.title: AI trade drags Nasdaq lower
themes.summary: Megacap tech led the decline: Alphabet fell about 4.1%, Amazon about 3.3%, Tesla about 2.7% and Meta about 2.4% (Market Alleys; Yahoo Finance).

themes.title: Nvidia falls before results
themes.summary: Nvidia closed down 4.12% at $156.14 after a report that its board is not considering bringing back former CEO Jensen Huang; it reports results Tuesday (Yahoo Finance).

themes.title: Chipmakers hit by new restrictions
themes.summary: Semiconductors led the selling after the U.S. tightened restrictions on advanced chip access abroad; Micron fell 7.62%, Teradyne 7.07% and Intel 7.02% (Yahoo Finance; 24/7 Wall St.).

themes.title: Volatility jumps, yields steady
themes.summary: The VIX rose about 19.8% to 23.12, while the 10-year Treasury yield edged down to about 5.12% (Yahoo Finance).

themes.title: Crypto-linked stocks slide
themes.summary: Coinbase, Circle and Strategy fell 7% to 8% and Robinhood dropped about 5.6% premarket as Bitcoin traded near its lowest level since July (Yahoo Finance; CryptoTicker).

sectors.name: Technology
sectors.note: Down about 2% to 3% during the session, the weakest sector, with Micron, Teradyne, Intel and Dell each down about 7% (24/7 Wall St.).

sectors.name: Defensive Sectors
sectors.note: Consumer staples rose about 1%; Molina Healthcare gained 11.27%, Tyson Foods 8.72% and Centene 4.91% (24/7 Wall St.).

sectors.name: Energy
sectors.note: Under pressure as WTI crude fell about 3.7%; Coterra Energy was among the day's biggest losers, down 8.62% (Yahoo Finance; 24/7 Wall St.).

sectors.name: Financials
sectors.note: Big banks including JPMorgan, Bank of America, Citigroup and Wells Fargo fell about 2% amid reports of app outages; JPMorgan closed down 2.28% (Yahoo Finance; Market Alleys).

watch_list.why: Nvidia reports after the close on Nov. 17, its first results since Jensen Huang stepped down, with an EPS estimate of about $2.52; Home Depot and Disney report before the open (Market Alleys; Yahoo Finance).
The IPO is scheduled to price Wednesday, Nov. 18, and is expected to begin trading Thursday, Nov. 19, targeting a valuation of around $1.4 trillion (24/7 Wall St.; Yahoo Finance).

U.S. October retail sales and minutes from the October Fed meeting are due this week, with a December rate hike fully priced after a hotter-than-expected October CPI (Market Alleys; 24/7 Wall St.; Zerocap).
